[[image:Farmaddinggateloc.png|right|thumb|200px|Location of gate]]
The '''Far Madding Gate''' is the southern gate at the city of [[Caemlyn]]. The gate leads south to the Far Madding Road. [[Arymilla]]'s main force attacks the Far Madding Gate to the [[Caemlyn#New City|New City]].
